answer: Here is one mechanism that works: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because violet only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, lotus is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any quill approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
